blocks.heading: Durable Standalone Job Title in India

items.text: Industry job-board tracking through 2026 shows a consistent pattern: postings with the exact title "Prompt Engineer" have been declining, while postings that list prompt engineering as a required skill inside other job titles, such as AI engineer, LLM engineer, or AI product manager, have grown sharply.
This is not unique to prompt engineering.
